scripts.start: set EXPO_NO_DEPENDENCY_VALIDATION=1&& set EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1&& expo start
scripts.start:tunnel: set EXPO_NO_DEPENDENCY_VALIDATION=1&& set EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1&& expo start --tunnel
scripts.android:run: powershell -Command "$projectRoot = (Resolve-Path '.').Path; $projectParent = Split-Path $projectRoot -Parent; $projectName = Split-Path $projectRoot -Leaf; $projectDrive = 'X:'; $sdkDrive = 'S:'; $gradleDrive = 'G:'; cmd /c \"subst $projectDrive /d\" *> $null; cmd /c \"subst $sdkDrive /d\" *> $null; cmd /c \"subst $gradleDrive /d\" *> $null; subst $projectDrive $projectParent; subst $sdkDrive \"$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Android\Sdk\"; subst $gradleDrive \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.gradle\"; try { $env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; $env:ANDROID_HOME = $sdkDrive; $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $sdkDrive; $env:GRADLE_USER_HOME = $gradleDrive; $env:Path = \"C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr\bin;$sdkDrive\\platform-tools;$sdkDrive\\emulator;$env:Path\"; $env:NODE_ENV = 'development'; Set-Location \"$projectDrive\\$projectName\\android\"; .\\gradlew.bat app:installDebug --max-workers 1 --no-parallel -PreactNativeArchitectures=x86_64 } finally { Set-Location $projectRoot; cmd /c \"subst $projectDrive /d\" *> $null; cmd /c \"subst $sdkDrive /d\" *> $null; cmd /c \"subst $gradleDrive /d\" *> $null }"
scripts.ios: set EXPO_NO_DEPENDENCY_VALIDATION=1&& set EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1&& expo start --ios
scripts.web: set EXPO_NO_DEPENDENCY_VALIDATION=1&& set EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1&& expo start --web
